summary: A log cabin and pole tower on Taylor Ridge near Republic, WA, dated to 1928 or 1930; a 1942 Army aircraft-warning post; removed or destroyed in the 1940s.

facts.design: Log cabin at the base of a pole tower with a 6x6 cab (30 feet per the register and Rex's page; 40 feet per Willhite)
facts.status_note: Removed or destroyed in the 1940s; no source describes what remains today
facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, Colville National Forest

events.note: Register and Rex's page date the log cabin and pole tower to 1928
Late-September 1930 newspaper item reports the tower and cabin being erected; Willhite says the site was a camp before 1930
July 1931 item says the tower and cabin were completed
Aeneas Creek Fire of 1934 covered much of the Taylor Ridge area
Sources give only the decade, the 1940s: register says removed, Rex's page says destroyed, Willhite says abandoned or destroyed. Year 1940 is a placeholder for the decade
Aircraft Warning Service post, activated March 30, deactivated August 3, 1942
Registered November 23, 2012 on the Former Fire Lookout Sites register
Reported fire loss of the original privy and a tripod-supported phone line; the author did not know what was found

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and Rex's page date the log cabin and pole tower to 1928. Willhite and the Forest Lookouts page place the tower in 1930, with completion reported in July 1931. The story reports both and does not pick one.
The register and Rex's page give a 30-foot pole tower; Willhite gives 40 feet. No height_m is recorded for this reason.

The register, Rex's page and Willhite agree the tower and cabin ended in the 1940s, but they give different wording (removed, destroyed, abandoned or destroyed). Year 1940 in the events is a placeholder for the decade.

notes_for_editor: Brief's elevation_m 1886.7 matches 6,190 ft given by Rex's page and Willhite. Brief lat/lon (48.80661, -118.37851) was not checked against a source; no page read gives coordinates. Confidence is medium because the build year and tower height disagree across pages and the end date is only a decade. Access is not stated on any page read, so no access fact was recorded. The Willhite page says the author has not visited the site; no visit or access source was found in the two searches. Photos: Willhite lists captioned images, but no image URLs or licenses were read, so none added.
